2607.14888.title: Innocuous-Seeming Data, Latent Ideology: Ideological Generalisation in Finetuned LLMs
2607.14888.paper_summary: Finetuning language models on small, curated datasets is standard practice for adapting them to specific policies or domains. We show that finetuning on narrow, factually-defensible, moderation-passing data can cause broad ideological shifts across unrelated domains, while preserving general capabilities. Training GPT-4.1 on right- or left-leaning economics Q&A yields matched ideological shifts on topics such as criminal justice, the environment, and cultural taste. The same effect appears with plausibly-deployed datasets such as workplace HR policy and practical finance queries, as well as on a science-pseudoscience axis where food-safety finetuning increases sycophantic agreement with users expressing false health beliefs. We call this phenomenon ideological generalisation and propose a methodology to measure two properties: breadth, how far the shift reaches across topics absent from training, and amplification, how much finetuning intensifies the shift relative to few-shot prompting on the same examples. We show that few-shot prompting indicates the direction of generalisation but finetuning pushes the model to further extremes, including to far out-of-distribution outputs such as endorsements of race-IQ connections and political violence. The effect replicates on Gemma-3, holds under judge-free evaluations and external benchmarks, survives mixing with generic data, and leaves GSM8K accuracy within $\pm 1$pp of the baseline.
2607.14888.paper_summary_zh: 在小型、精心策劃的數據集上微調語言模型是將其適應於特定政策或領域的標準做法。 我們顯示，在狹窄、事實上可辯護、通過審核的數據上進行微調可以在無關領域引起廣泛的意識形態轉變，同時保留一般能力。 在右派或左派經濟問答上訓練GPT-4.1會在刑事司法、環境和文化品味等主題上產生相應的意識形態轉變。 在可合理部署的數據集上，例如工作場所人力資源政策和實用財務查詢，出現了相同的效果，以及在科學與偽科學的軸線上，食品安全的微調增加了與表達錯誤健康信念的用戶的阿諛奉承。 我們稱這種現象為意識形態泛化，並提出了一種方法來測量兩個特性：廣度，即轉變在訓練中缺失的主題上延伸的遠度，以及放大，即微調相對於在相同示例上進行少量提示時如何加強轉變。 我們顯示，少量提示指示了泛化的方向，但微調將模型推向更極端的情況，包括遠離分佈的輸出，例如對種族智商聯繫和政治暴力的支持。 這一效果在Gemma-3上重現，並在無評委評估和外部基準下保持穩定，與通用數據混合後仍然有效，並使GSM8K的準確性保持在基線的$\pm 1$pp範圍內。
